note: 48,800 steps ≈ 1,000 epochs at batch 1,024 on 50k images. Paper sweeps batch size {256..4096}, epochs {100..1000}, temperature {0.1, 0.5, 1.0} and colour strength {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0} for CIFAR-10; values here are one representative setting. Warmup = 10 epochs. ImageNet protocol (batch 4096, LR 4.8, tau 0.1, 100-1000 epochs, blur on) requires a TPU/GPU cluster and an ImageNet loader.
